core.title: Heart-Shaped Cast Iron Door Pull, Acorn RP1BP

text.description_html:
Acorn RP1BP, Heart Shaped Cast Iron Gate Door Pull

The Cast Iron Gate Door Pull is great for garden gates or small outside doors; and will blend in beautifully with many landscapes. Acorn's RP1BP features heart shaped mounting ends. It has an easy screw-in installation. The beautiful rough black iron finish has a lifetime no rust warranty. The weathered appearance of cast iron duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals.

If you want a heart shaped latch to lock your gate, we recommend using an Acorn Rim Gate Latch for a matching set.

Specifications of the Heart Cast Iron Door Pull Acorn-RP1BP:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 10-1/2"
  • Width: 2-5/8"
  • Projection: 1-3/4"
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
